paper_title: Exact Solution for Two δ-Interacting Bosons on a Ring in the Presence of a δ-Barrier: Asymmetric Bethe Ansatz for Spatially Odd States (Olshanii, 2025, SciPost Physics Core submission)

deeper_metadata.revision_intent: Improve alignment after the prior 4.9/5.0 audit by making the construction certificate, spectrum identity, symmetry propagation, and asymptotic diagnostic more explicit while preserving strict JSON and LaTeX-compilation constraints.

rubric_interpretation.top_level_shape: Exactly paper_title, contiguous deeper_reasoning_1 through deeper_reasoning_4 string fields, and one deeper_metadata object.
rubric_interpretation.proof_format: Each deeper_reasoning_k value is a standalone LaTeX fragment intended to compile with only article, amsmath, and amssymb.
rubric_interpretation.metadata_policy: All audit, trace, revision, and residual-risk information is stored only inside deeper_metadata; proof content is not duplicated there.

deeper_reasoning_1.title: End-to-end Bethe-root-to-physical-eigenpair certificate
deeper_reasoning_1.goal_alignment: Shows that each ordered real Bethe root produces a periodic bosonic point-inversion-odd eigenfunction of the physical Hamiltonian with the quadratic energy.
deeper_reasoning_1.scientific_payoff: Connects the auxiliary nonlocal Hamiltonian trick, eight-wave kinetic degeneracy, boundary compatibility, and physical-sector projection into one exactness certificate.
deeper_reasoning_1.nontrivial_advance_over_sources: Chains several core lemmas into the complete G1 success predicate rather than re-proving a single local symmetry or contact-term fact.
deeper_reasoning_1.formal_sharpness: Restricts the conclusion to repulsive parameters, ordered real rapidities, and the explicit ABA seed construction selected by B1=B2=0.
deeper_reasoning_1.low_value_rejection_audit: Avoids duplicating the full explicit trigonometric seed formula, which is already represented in goals_03 and would reduce clarity.
controlled_external_lemmas: Distributional annihilation of delta(u) by a continuous function with zero trace at u=0
Piecewise sector eigenfunctions satisfying the matching conditions define an eigenfunction with delta interactions
deeper_reasoning_1.known_residual_risks_and_mitigation: The explicit seed substitution is summarised as a compatibility premise rather than expanded term by term; this is mitigated by making the residual role of B1 and B2 explicit.

deeper_reasoning_2.title: Necessary-and-sufficient spectral identity inside the declared real-rapidity ABA class
deeper_reasoning_2.goal_alignment: Identifies the exact ABA-produced odd-sector spectral set with the quadratic image of the Bethe-root set.
deeper_reasoning_2.scientific_payoff: Clarifies that B1=B2=0 are complete compatibility conditions for the construction class, not merely sufficient equations generating examples.
deeper_reasoning_2.nontrivial_advance_over_sources: Turns the root-set definition and energy formula into a formal equality of spectral sets with explicit necessity and sufficiency directions.
deeper_reasoning_2.formal_sharpness: Completeness is explicitly scoped to the real-rapidity eight-plane-wave ABA class, avoiding unsupported claims about complex rapidities or the even sector.
deeper_reasoning_2.low_value_rejection_audit: Rejects a weaker derivation that would only restate the energy formula without proving the two set inclusions.
controlled_external_lemmas: Boundary and jump residuals vanish if and only if the two reduced Bethe equations vanish
deeper_reasoning_2.known_residual_risks_and_mitigation: The global spectral completeness is not claimed beyond the declared ABA class; this avoids overreach relative to the goals file.

deeper_reasoning_3.title: Six-sector reconstruction as a constraint-propagation theorem
deeper_reasoning_3.goal_alignment: Shows why two seed regions suffice to enforce bosonic symmetry, point-inversion oddness, and removal of the auxiliary nonlocal contact term.
deeper_reasoning_3.scientific_payoff: Explains the structural reason the Asymmetric Bethe Ansatz can solve the physical odd sector using a reduced sector ansatz.
deeper_reasoning_3.nontrivial_advance_over_sources: Combines sector reconstruction, exchange symmetry, mirror oddness, and delta-line annihilation into a single mechanism-level result.
deeper_reasoning_3.formal_sharpness: Uses only the six sectors and seed-trace compatibility; does not assume unproved properties outside the reconstructed domain.
deeper_reasoning_3.low_value_rejection_audit: Rejects a purely verbal explanation of the six-sector formula and gives an explicit symmetry-chain proof instead.
controlled_external_lemmas: Continuity of matched sector traces gives a well-defined trace on x1+x2=0
deeper_reasoning_3.known_residual_risks_and_mitigation: Trace compatibility is taken from the seed matching system; the proof focuses on propagation rather than re-expanding seed algebra.

deeper_reasoning_4.title: Large-repulsion sign diagnostic for the derivative-delta pseudopotential
deeper_reasoning_4.goal_alignment: Proves the sign structure required by G2 and connects the positive xi^{-2} coefficient to the non-Hermitian-potential diagnostic.
deeper_reasoning_4.scientific_payoff: Turns the large-xi formula into an interpretable statement about when the derivative-delta object is and is not a legitimate perturbative model.
deeper_reasoning_4.nontrivial_advance_over_sources: Extends the coefficient sign result into the second-order Hermitian perturbation contradiction that gives the result its diagnostic value.
deeper_reasoning_4.formal_sharpness: Applies only for xi_B>0 and distinct positive eta_1, eta_2 in the large-positive-xi regime with a controlled O(xi^{-3}) remainder.
deeper_reasoning_4.low_value_rejection_audit: Avoids only reporting the expansion formula; proves the coefficient signs and the perturbation-theoretic consequence.
controlled_external_lemmas: Nondegenerate Hermitian second-order perturbation corrections have denominators E0^(0)-En^(0)<=0 for excited states
deeper_reasoning_4.known_residual_risks_and_mitigation: The first-order equality with the derivative-delta bilinear form is sourced as a premise from goals_03; the proof contributes the sign and contradiction chain.
